name: Track id with no matching track file
description: A target whose track_id doesn't match any file in data/tracks/ (e.g. the quiz offered a role that was never actually curated into a track yet, or a stale/corrupted profile). Found by this suite as a real crash (engine.recommend raised an unhandled FileNotFoundError instead of handing over cleanly, unlike every other lookup in this codebase); fixed in engine.py to return a clear error dict instead, the same honest-failure style as fetch_chair_page/find_thesis_info. This persona now guards against that regressing.
expect_error: Unknown track_id 'data_science' — no track file exists for it yet.
